```{r}
ui <- fluidPage(
  
  theme=shinythemes::shinytheme("united"),
  
  selectInput("filter",
              "select country",
             choices = c("USA",
         "Afghanistan",
         "Albania",
         "Angola",
         "Australia",
         "Belgium",
         "Bangladesh",
         "bulgaria",
  selected = "USA")),
  
  selectInput("y",
              "Select Year Variable",
              choices = c("life_expectancy",
                          "Co2_emissions",
                          "population"),
              selected = "population"),
  
  plotOutput("plot", width="600px", height= "6000px")
  
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  output$plot <- renderPlot({
    
  gapminder %>% 
      filter(name==".data[[input$filter]]") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=year, y=.data[[input$y]]))+
  geom_line(aes(color= "tomato"))+
  geom_point(na.rm=T, shape=1, color= "blue")+
  scale_x_continuous()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=60, hjust=1))+
  labs(title="countries throughout the years",
       x="Year")+
      theme_minimal()
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```

```{r}
 gapminder %>% 
 filter((year>=2000 & year<=2025) & name=="USA") %>%

  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=60, hjust=1))+
  labs(title="GDP per Capita in the USA, 2000-2025",
```
